# Later Love UK

> Independent, sourced guides for people dating over 50 in the UK: what dating sites such as OurTime UK, eharmony and Match really cost, how to cancel, and how to avoid romance scams and stay safe on first dates. Written by Bala Danmeri in Somerset. Some links are disclosed affiliate links.

## Guides
- [Is OurTime UK Worth It? An Honest Look for Over-50s](https://somersetnomad.github.io/Later-Love-UK/is-ourtime-uk-worth-it/): OurTime UK is built for over-50s, but you can't message for free and its reviews are poor. Here's who it suits, what it costs and what to watch for.
- [OurTime UK Cost in 2026, and How to Cancel](https://somersetnomad.github.io/Later-Love-UK/ourtime-uk-cost-and-how-to-cancel/): OurTime UK costs £39.99 for one month or £19.99 a month over six. Here's every price, the cheapest way to try it, and how to cancel without being charged again.
- [OurTime vs eharmony vs Match for Over-50s (UK)](https://somersetnomad.github.io/Later-Love-UK/ourtime-vs-eharmony-vs-match-over-50/): OurTime, eharmony and Match compared for UK over-50s: prices, who's on each, what's free, and which suits you. Prices checked October 2026.
- [Romance Scams After 50: Warning Signs and What to Do](https://somersetnomad.github.io/Later-Love-UK/romance-scams-over-50-warning-signs/): Romance fraud cost UK victims over £102 million last year, and people aged 55 to 74 lost the most. The warning signs, and what to do if it happens.
- [First Date Safety After 50: A Practical Checklist](https://somersetnomad.github.io/Later-Love-UK/first-date-safety-over-50/): A first date after 50 should feel exciting, not risky. A practical checklist for before, during and after, plus Ask for Angela and Clare's Law.
